findings.summary: Readonly parameter ownership checks skip checker resolution for representations other than borrowed array views.
Unique array-union selection scans members without building filtered result arrays.
Numeric lowering memoizes non-null assertion inspection within each expression.
Retained child-node counts use the stored size after materialization and traversal checks.
Own-field enumeration filters only when exclusion keys are present.
Scoped engine discovery shares an ancestry set and candidate collector instead of copying them recursively.
Nullable narrowing short-circuits before unnecessary union scans and checker queries.
Array destructuring computes invariant default-storage information once per pattern.
Object defaults name the presence check and selected payload separately.
